title: Race condition: counter++ twice each
description: Possible final values range from 2 to 4.

input.code:
# Each thread does counter++ twice. Which final values are possible?
shared counter = 0

thread A
  MOV i, 2
loop:
  LOAD r, counter
  ADD r, 1
  STORE counter, r
  SUB i, 1
  JNZ i, loop

thread B
  MOV i, 2
loop:
  LOAD r, counter
  ADD r, 1
  STORE counter, r
  SUB i, 1
  JNZ i, loop
